metadata.title: {brand} | Affordable, Reliable Global Cloud Infrastructure
metadata.description: {brand} provides developers, startups and enterprises with cost-effective, highly available cloud servers, networking and storage. Predictable cost, stable operations, from web hosting to production workloads.

slides.title: Reliable cloud infrastructure, at a fair price
slides.subtitle: A global cloud services brand focused on overseas markets. Get reliable cloud capabilities at a reasonable cost — on-demand, stable and predictable infrastructure for websites, APIs and enterprise workloads.

slides.title: Compute built for performance and isolation
slides.subtitle: Bare metal and high-performance compute with dedicated physical resources — low latency, high throughput and predictable performance for databases, rendering, AI training and compute-intensive workloads.

slides.title: Scalable data storage and backup
slides.subtitle: Object storage and data protection that scale on demand, with lifecycle management and backup workflows so data of any retention period stays safe and under control.

items.q: How do I request a trial?
items.a: Submit the contact form and our team will reach out within one business day to confirm your scenario and arrange a trial or demo.
The first release supports pay-as-you-go billing based on actual usage. Prices and details follow official product documentation and terms.

items.q: How do I migrate existing workloads?
items.a: Common images and standard deployment flows are supported, plus migration consulting. For complex cases, contact sales for architecture guidance.
24/7 tickets and email support; scope and response time follow official terms of service.

items.q: How is my data stored and protected?
items.a: Data is stored in the region you select or agree on. Purpose, retention and deletion channels are described in the Privacy Policy and Terms.
Availability targets and SLA commitments follow signed, deliverable terms — marketing pages make no promises beyond contracts.

about.title: Reliable cloud capability at a fair price
about.intro: {brand} is a global cloud services brand focused on overseas markets. We believe reliable cloud infrastructure should not come with high costs or complex lock-in.
about.story: From developers and startups to enterprise teams, more workloads than ever need stable, predictable cloud resources. {brand} brings together compute, storage and networking with clear specs and transparent billing — so teams get dependable cloud capability at a reasonable cost, from a first website to production workloads.

principles.name: Transparent cost
principles.desc: Clear billing logic and resource specs keep every cloud spend predictable.

principles.name: Reliability first
principles.desc: Redundancy, health checks and failover reduce single points of failure.

principles.name: Global network
principles.desc: Edge networking optimized for overseas markets improves access worldwide.

principles.name: Ongoing support
principles.desc: 24/7 technical support from selection through operations.

about.architectureDesc: From a global edge network and redundant infrastructure, to compute, storage and networking capabilities, to unified support and operations — {brand} uses a clear layered architecture to power workloads of any size.

architectureLayers.name: Infrastructure layer
architectureLayers.desc: Global edge network and multi-region data centers with multi-layer redundancy.

architectureLayers.name: Service layer
architectureLayers.desc: Elastic compute, bare metal, object storage and network acceleration, combined on demand.

architectureLayers.name: Support & operations
architectureLayers.desc: 24/7 support, usage monitoring and status transparency across the full lifecycle.
